profile.headline: Manager and Lead Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am an outgoing, productive and personable person who can bring a lot of value add to a company.  I have held leadership roles in addition to developing cutting line technologies in my field. I know , C#, ASP.NET, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, CSS and HTML5, MS Logic Apps, SQL T-SQL, SQL stored procedures, SQL SSRS reports, VB.NET, C, C++, IIS management and MSAccess. I also have extensive knowledge with Microsoft Azure development ranging from App Services, SQL Services to Visual Studio DevLabs and extensive knowledge of Azure Data Factory.

I am experienced in database administration for SQL Server 2008 R2 and above as well as server administration including setting up users, groups, FTP access and SSRS report administration management.

 I also have training in Project Management and have utilized these techniques in my roles.

My objective is to use my skill base to help my employer to be the best in its industry. I also want to continue enhancing my own knowledge base by keeping updated on evolving languages and processes.

positions.title: Manager and Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Kinetix Solutions is an IT Services company specializing in managed services and development opportunities for medium sized companies.  We are very familiar with the health and law businesses.

I am a Microsoft Certified Associate S/W development manager and lead senior developer responsible for developing web applications and mobile apps for our clients using C# ASP.NET, MS Azure Apps and SQL Databases, Services, SSIS packages, MS Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory and MS Access, PHP, MySql and CRM platforms. I also develop SQL stored procedures on SQL server 2008R2 and above, perform SQL database administration and server administration, setting up web sites on IIS 6.0 and later as well SSL certificates, I am also experienced at developing SSRS reports on SQL server 2005 and later.

My team consists 4 developers responsible for all development requirements starting with SWLC, continuing with code development through testing and one UI designer responsible for all images, content, SEO and logo design.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
I write programs that interface with the 3D CAD system CATIA. Most development activities involve automating the design and processing of mechincal, electrical, piping, structural, equipment parts and systems as well as 2D drawings. Most of the coding is done using VB.NET. Other languages include C, C++ and C#.  

I have also written scripts for SmarTeam, a databse used with CATIA

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I worked in the Data Conversion group migrating 3D data into CATIA using automation.  I developed programs in VB.NET/VB6 to reduce migration time and manual effort. 

I also worked with ENOVIA APIs and CATIA V6.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Architect and developer for a unique program that converted ProE 2D drawings into CATIA 2D drawings with an active link between the solids in the view with the 3D part file.  The entire process used VB6 on Windows, C on UNIX and FTP protocol. The process is still used by Dassault Systemes for data translation.

Architect and developer of a product that converted IGES data into CATIA(a major 3D CAD system), 3D solids. The product was sold for 10 years.
Developed a translation program for Newport News Shipbuilding (now Northrup Grumman) to convert their mechanical, piping and equipment designs from their own in-house CAD program to CATIA. The language used was C.

Lead programmer developing automation and process programs for CATIA, . Customer base included TRW,  Boeing, Parker, Husqvarna and others.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Manufacturing Eng on a printer assembly line.

Lead ME in several computer development departments.  

Developed state of the art, first of its kind nurses workstation for use in hospitals. Received a patent for keyboard design.

Headed up development of hardened tablet for JB Hunt trucking.  First computer in IBM to survive 6 foot drop onto a concrete floor and could be submersed under water and still continue operating. It also included satellite connection capability with the Qualcomm communications system.

projects.title: ProE to CATIA 2D Drawing Conversion Tool
projects.description:
This project involved developing a one of a kind tool to convert ProE 2D CAD drawings into CATIA V5 CAD drawings while maintaining the link between the 3D parts shown in each view with the 3D part file.  No tool existed and still does not exist to do this conversion.  I was the only developer for the project which involved writing code on a Windows platform using VB6 and on a UNIX platform using C and FTP protocol.  The rexx scripting language was also a component.  

This program enabled drawings created in ProE to be migrated to CATIA and maintain the link between the 3D parts displayed in a view with the part itself.  If a change was made to the part the change was conveyed to all 2D views in a drawing document the part was linked to.

This process is still used by the Dassualt Systemes company in their data translation group.

projects.title: IGES to CATIA Conversion Tool
projects.description:
The tool I architected and developed was based on a need for companies to migrate 3D solid data to the CATIA 3D CAD system.  The program was written in C++ on the UNIX platform.  The project involved developing algorithms using both polynomial and NURBS equations.

IBM released the program for sale and was bought by many companies that used the CATIA V4 CAD system.
